description: How good the logged predictions were, from the local ledger only (never contacts Suunto, needs no credentials, writes nothing): overall, per kind and per `rule`: logged, n (scored: hit or miss), hits, misses, unresolvable, voided (counted apart, never scored), unscored; and, ONLY with at least 20 scored predictions in that group, hitRate, meanProbability, brier (the mean of (probability - outcome)^2; 0 is perfect; lower is better), brierBaseRate (what always saying the overall hit rate would have scored: a brier below it means the probabilities carried information) and a calibration table by stated probability (0-0.2, 0.2-0.4, 0.4-0.6, 0.6-0.8, 0.8-1: n, meanProbability, and hitRate when the bucket has at least 5). Below 20 scored the rates are null, verdict is 'insufficient' and statement says how many are missing: no claim is made. `basis` reports the predictions scored from a confirmed draft_session_log (a reps_hit whose sets began as the guide's plan) apart from all others: { draftConfirmed: { n, hits, hitRate }, other: { n, hits, hitRate } }, each hitRate shown only from 20; they still count in the overall figures. Unresolvable, voided and unscored predictions are never scored. Also: dueUnscored (call score_predictions), thresholds, recent (the 10 newest predictions with their status: hit, miss, unresolvable, void, due, open), notes. Output: { today, thresholds, dueUnscored, overall, byKind: [{ kind, ... }], byRule: [{ rule (null: none given), ... }], recent, notes }. Read-only.
name: get_prediction_stats
title: Get prediction statistics: hit rate, Brier score, calibration
